text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While we were out, Satono Crown suddenly 
stopped in her tracks.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Is that... Could it be, Paka Petit?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking in the direction Satono Crown 
points, there is a crane game filled with 
plushies themed after Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
A classmate let me touch it before. The 
outfit is reproduced really well!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
The stitching is so delicate, even Papa 
would be impressed by its quality! That's 
why I thought it was a luxury item, but—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: To think it was a prize from a game!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It feels rare to see Satono Crown's eyes 
sparkle this much. If it captivates her 
that deeply, then—
choice_data_list: Shall I get that for you?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Are you sure? I would love to! For my 
sake... No, for Father's... Wait, no!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
And in turn, for the sake of the Satono 
family, please!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose this game!!
